assets.name: Sage_AI System Context
assets.notes: Fifth release. The system instructions as in the library on 11/16/2026. Both plugins are tested. The plugins cannot trigger the refresh of a linked table, so Sage_AI lists the documents that embed it and asks the Product Owner to refresh each one. No script applies edits to a Document. The Sage_AI Doc Edits skill and the Sage_AI Edits script are retired and removed from the repository. The 20261114 and 20261112 files stay as history. Sixth release, the same day, so it replaces the 20261116 file. The mission rules carry the brief outline, the live doc practice, and the brief for the next mission as a standard closing deliverable. Deliver Changes to Documents gains two rules for linked tables. Sage_AI Skill and Sage_AI Context point to the Lexicon. Seventh release. Sage_AI reads the Product Meta and the Advisory Board from dated Markdown files in the Product Owner's Drive, and the overrides moved from the Project Instructions into the Product Meta. The Project Instructions are a fixed stub. Sage_AI reads each Growth Factor AI Meta from the clone, with the website page as the fallback. A Skills section names how a skill is installed. The Product Owner LinkedIn Content skill is published at version 1. Eighth release. The Product Meta Skeleton is in the repository and Sage_AI builds the first Product Meta from it. The Advisory Board is no longer written for a new Product Owner. Named assets are written with capitals and led by their names. Stub and Skeleton point to the Lexicon. A version pending the Product Owner's signature is put in front of them with a link before the mission closes. Ninth release, the same day, so it replaces the 20261119 file. Deliver Changes to Documents says the Drive canEdit flag does not predict whether the Docs plugin can edit. The Project Registry rows carry a document_state of Document Present or Document Missing. A second Product Meta change on the same date replaces that day's file. The house style never uses a horizontal rule. Tenth release. The Brief Review step asks what can be removed or simplified, so a brief is made lean, clean, and light. Eleventh release. The slate carries created_at and updated_at fields. A mission closes when the Product Owner confirms the work is done. The Transition checks the open tactics in the Development Plan for other pending System Context improvements. The Lexicon is named as the place that defines the System's terms, and the rule for building it moved to the Product Meta overrides. Twelfth release. Each log entry is one JSON file, built from the Log Entry Skeleton, in X.1.3 Logs for marketing and X.2.3 Logs for development. A second Product Meta file on the same day takes a letter after the date, and a second Advisory Board change on the same day replaces that day's file. A drafted document, a brief included, is reviewed in listening mode, and the Transition slate review stays in interview mode. A question is asked only when information is needed. The Skills section lists the installed skills. A list in a brief names the thing and its location and states no state.

assets.name: Sage_AI Product Owner LinkedIn Content
assets.notes: First release. Turns a transcript, a captured interview, or a Sage_AI interview into fifteen LinkedIn posts, each with three hooks, image text, share text, and an HTML image card, as one validated ProductSage import file. Reads the Product Owner's content profile for envelope values, brand slots, and style overrides. Carries templates A to O, the style rules, the import format at schema version 1.0, the interview questions, and a validator with a self test.

assets.name: Sage_AI Project Instructions Stub
assets.notes: First release. The fixed Project Instructions for Sage_AI 3.0. It is the same for every Product Owner and has one optional slot, the Product Meta folder ID. Paste it into the Project Instructions. Where the version line in the installed stub is older than this version, paste the new stub and carry the folder ID across.

assets.name: Product Meta Skeleton
assets.notes: First release. The structure and rules of the Product Meta, with bracketed variables and blanks. Sage_AI copies it and fills it in with the Product Owner, then writes the result as a dated file in the Product Owner's Drive. It is filled in and not used as it is.

assets.name: Log Entry Skeleton
assets.notes: First release. The structure and rules of one log entry, with bracketed variables as blanks. A Transition copies it, fills it in for the mission, and writes the result as one JSON file in X.1.3 Logs for marketing or X.2.3 Logs for development. A development entry adds claude_md_snapshot, commit_reference, verified_by_hand, defects_found, decisions, and rules_added. It is filled in and not used as it is.

assets.name: Growth Factor AI Meta
assets.notes: One folder for each Growth Factor, named by its slug. Each folder holds dated files, AI_Meta_{slug}_{YYYYMMDD}.md, and the latest date in the name is live. Older files stay as history. The website AI Meta page is the fallback.
